source.derivedFrom: Supercell csv_logic/ of the 160635007 client: the 2026-11-03 update folder over the install-time pack, decoded by tools/decode_sc_assets.py (each pack's MANIFEST.json carries its per-file hashes)
source.overlayRule: effective row = CSV row + TOML overlay (table-level *.toml, then csv_logic/characters/*.toml [KIND.Name] sections in file-name order); overlay wins; a TOML value on a CSV-typed column is coerced to that type and the build fails on a mismatch
source.warning: Native game asset extraction mirrored by an independent project. Base forms only; no inference from HP, cost, rarity or mass. Absent native boolean means the extractor resolves the native default false; null below means not applicable or unknown.

troopSpeed: Native Speed millitiles per50ms, *.48 units/s, measured
